fieldNotes.truckGate: The site is fully enclosed by a metal perimeter fence and masonry wall. Street View on Arenth Avenue (pano 34.00407,-117.90599) clearly shows a swing/sliding metal gate across the truck entrance lane, with the process plant (silos, tanks) behind it.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the gate - Street View shows only wall-mounted signs beside the gate; no 1-3-vehicle-footprint booth structure. Small structures visible inside the fence are process/utility, not a gatehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Controlled gate with no guard booth - implies badge/intercom/remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Tight 284,000 sq ft refrigerated plant; loading occurs on the south/SW face with a covered dock canopy and trailers backed in. Estimated ~14 doors, banded 10-25 (low confidence - dense rooftop process equipment and canopy obscure the dock line).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a handful of trailers parked inside the fence along the SW edge; no dedicated drop-yard lot - banded 0-10, dropYard false.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight urban site - the gate opens directly onto Arenth Avenue with almost no stacking depth between the road and the docks; a truck queue would spill onto the public street.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Very short gate-to-dock approach; 1-2 trucks of room at most.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the north property edge as a through corridor; no spur enters the building.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One integrated plant plus an SE admin/office building and an on-site wastewater treatment area - counted as one facility, buildingCount 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense City of Industry / San Gabriel Valley industrial fabric - clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Limited paved interior area between the gate and the dock canopy provides minimal inside staging.
